title: A Chief rename that lands while its name field is open stays, also after a relaunch (2026-11-07: "renaming chief doesnt work")

steps.title: Chief settings open, the keyboard in the name field (it shows Chief)
The Chief is renamed Chief mom while the field is open (the save's echo, the CLI, the phone)
The card closes with no keystroke in the field (a click outside): the Home list and the header keep the Chief's name
Each surface's name and the Chief's record
Quit and reopen the app: the name is still there
Each surface's name and the Chief's record after the relaunch
